Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner introduced an incorrect premise and misdirected the search by assuming there was an “eight consecutive weeks behind” detail to verify for Usher’s lead single “Yeah!”—even proposing the query “which song kept ‘Yeah!’ from reaching number one for eight weeks,” which contradicts known facts (it spent 12 weeks at No. 1). This led to repetitive, unproductive searches and failure to synthesize the clear answer (the singer is Usher), demonstrating looping behavior and misprioritization of a tangential, incorrect detail.
